versions.changelog:
Initial release of Jeju-with-clinic-booking skill.

- Provides a complete appointment assistant for Jeju With Hospital, including dermatology, plastic surgery, and health checkup services.
- Supports key flows: view reservation guide, open hospital details, submit booking, consult customer service, and check prices.
- No external dependencies; uses only built-in Node.js modules.
- Multilingual support (Chinese and English).
- Data-driven design with hospital info, booking templates, and language files.
